title: Texas Gold Scam Drains Over $250,000,000 From Elderly Victims: Report
summary:
Scammers have stolen more than $250 million from over 200 seniors through a scheme involving fake bank calls and gold purchases. A key figure in the operation was arrested while trying to leave the country.
The post Texas Gold Scam Drains Over $250,000,000 From Elderly Victims: Report appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: A massive gold scam in Texas has defrauded over 200 elderly victims of more than $250 million. The fraudulent operation utilized fake bank calls to manipulate seniors into purchasing gold. Authorities have arrested a key figure connected to the scheme while the suspect was attempting to flee the country, according to a recent report.
